text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up — two policy updates rolling out next Monday (2026-04-06): 1) PTO proration for mid-year hires; 2) Mandatory 'Security Microcert for Managers' — required for people managers with direct reports. Please read and action: https://redwood.company/internal/policies/2026-q2-proration-and-microcert-checklist :wave:

Jonas - Eng: Quick Q — how is proration calculated? Example for someone joining July 15?

Maya (People Ops): Proration = (remaining full pay-months in year / 12) * full annual PTO. So joining July 15 → remaining full months = 5 (Aug-Dec) → 5/12 * PTO. See doc for edge cases (mid-month hires, leaves): https://redwood.company/internal/handbook/pto

Priya - Manager: Are contractors and IC temps included in the microcert requirement? We have a contractor who manages other contractors.

Maya (People Ops): Short answer: no for contractors unless they're on payroll as managers. External contractors/agency leads are exempt. If you're unsure, ping me with the person and role. :+1:

Troy - Finance: For headcount & comp ops, we'll need a CSV export of manager completion status by team. Can we get that from People Ops console?

Maya (People Ops): Yep — HR admin command:
```
hrctl export-training --course security-microcert --fields manager_name,team,completed_at,email --format csv --since 2026-01-01 > manager_microcerts_2026Q2.csv
```
I'll run it Friday and drop the file in #people-ops-files. If you need scheduled weekly exports, tell me.

hr-bot: Reminder: 'Security Microcert for Managers' signups open now. Course link: https://learn.redwood.company/microcerts/security-managers — completion due 2026-05-01. Managers without completion will receive escalations after the deadline. (Automated reminder posted at 09:00 UTC)

Priya - Manager: Can we get an accommodation window for field managers on rotation? Some are in on-call during training windows.

Maya (People Ops): Yes — we have flexible windows. Choose 'asynchronous' option in the course or request an alternate proctored slot by emailing people-ops@redwood.company. Make sure you mark team members in the tracker like: team_name, person_email, requested_window.

Jonas - Eng: Thx. Will update my new hire checklist to include the proration calc and this microcert step.

Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll post a brief FAQ doc and the manager completion CSV after Friday's run. :thumbsup:
